realms.name: Mortal Body
realms.desc: Untrained flesh. Qi slips through you like water through sand.

realms.name: Qi Condensation
realms.desc: Nine layers of gathering qi into the dantian.

realms.name: Foundation Establishment
realms.desc: The dantian solidifies; the path is truly begun.

realms.name: Core Formation
realms.desc: A golden core condenses. Sects call you elder now.

realms.name: Nascent Soul
realms.desc: The core cracks and a soul is born within it.

realms.name: Soul Transformation
realms.desc: The soul reshapes body and fate.

realms.name: Void Refinement
realms.desc: You touch the void between heaven and earth.

realms.name: Tribulation Transcendence
realms.desc: Heaven sends lightning to test you. Survive it.

realms.name: Immortal Ascension
realms.desc: Few in any age. The world will remember your name.
